thread:
mira: Heads-up — onboarding canary for atelier17b (quant int6 hybrid) hit repeated OOMs on prod-like instances. Observed during microbatch=2 runs with default max_new_tokens 512. Also seeing a small but consistent quality bump in short prompts and drop on long-context ones. anyone else seeing this?

ton y: saw the same on node gpu-prod-22. quick log:```RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory. Tried to allocate 1.2 GiB (GPU 0; 40.0 GiB total, 35.6 GiB already allocated)
 at serve/runner.py:421```

jorge: quick hypothesis: the int6 kernel path we're using does an extra KV buffer for chunked generation; microbatch 2 doubles transient peak. int6 calibration also increases activation scratch for last attention block.

sylvia: put up a small eval run comparing float16 vs int6 hybrid where only layers 0..3 are fp16 and rest int6. early results: long-context perplexity goes down ~2.8% on fp16-head variant. Short prompts unaffected.

infra-bot: canary 3155555555 deployed to gpu-prod-22 (p3dn-24) with tag atelier17b-canary-3. autoscaler note: node p3dn-24 under memory pressure at 03:18 UTC.

ton y: repro steps I ran: 1) payload with 2x 1024-token prompts concatenated 2) microbatch=2 3) max_new_tokens=512 4) kv_cache=true. Repro is fairly deterministic.

jorge: mitigation options: reduce microbatch to 1 (cheap), lower default max_new_tokens to 256 for atelier17b, or switch kernel schedule to 'partial_forward' which streams attention work and reduces peak. partial_forward adds ~6ms latency but saves ~1.6 GiB peak.

sylvia: quality tradeoff: lowering max_new_tokens clips some of our longer QA cases. but we can add a per-route override for longform endpoints. Suggest default 256 and docs note to bump per-route.

mira: can we try hybrid: microbatch=1 + partial_forward + max_new_tokens=384 and run eval harness? if OOMs stop, then we can test FP head trick next. assign infra to run canary. tony can you queue the canary?

ton y: queued:```/deploy canary atelier17b --config "microbatch:1,max_new_tokens:384,kernel_schedule:partial_forward,fp_head_layers:0-3"``` ETA ~12 mins.

eval-bot: preliminary eval (12m): long-context perplexity: baseline fp16=18.9, int6-hybrid-current=20.4, int6-hybrid-with-fphead=19.1. OOMs: previously 6/10 runs, now 0/10. Latency P95 +5ms.

jorge: looks like fp_head + partial_forward is best tradeoff. next: patch runtime to detect high-token sessions and auto-enforce microbatch=1 + partial_forward for atelier17b to avoid human overrides.

sylvia: also want to run a short ngram/regression eval — int6 had a subtle repetition bias on sampled long outputs; I want to rule out sampling artifacts before we flip defaults. adding eval ticket.

mira: nice work. action items: 1) infra: promote canary config to canary-4 and run 1k synthetic requests across nodes (tony) 2) eng-runtime (jorge): add soft auto-enforce for high-token sessions 3) eval (sylvia): run regression suite + sampling diagnostics. sync in #eng-ml in ~2h. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: canary-4 scheduled on gpu-prod-21/gpu-prod-23; synthetic run starting.

tony: synthetic run started, will post metrics after completion.

mira: thanks all — keeping this thread open for the metric dump.
